findings: STOP blocks future dispatch before duplicate-slot reservation and before provider dispatch.
Pre-dispatch abort marks only the intended slot cancelled and starts no provider dispatch.
Post-dispatch cancel calls adapter.abort for the intended provider/session, performs no collect, and blocks replay without a second dispatch.
Timeout aborts the active provider/session, keeps retry_count=0, and blocks same-slot restart.
Raw provider evidence is retained in the returned result before classification output is consumed.
Malformed and UNKNOWN provider states remain non-success.
One provider failure does not erase successful peer raw evidence and does not enable fallback.
Mock/static bridge keeps live_ready=false and live_turn_executed=false.
